title: Quietly Rich Indian Cocoa Idli
description: A rich and velvety Indian dish featuring cocoa, this crowd-pleaser is a perfect treat for any occasion, and is also FODMAP-friendly. It is made with a special salt-bake method to give it a unique flavor.
instructions: Soak the idli rice and urad dal in water for at least 4 hours.
Grind the soaked rice and dal into a smooth batter using a blender or food processor.
In a separate bowl, mix together the cocoa powder, salt, and sugar.
Add the dry mixture to the batter and stir well.
Add the coconut milk and ghee or oil to the batter and mix until smooth.
If using fenugreek seeds, add them to the batter and stir well.
Pour the batter into idli molds and steam for 15-20 minutes.
Remove the idlis from the molds and serve hot.
